pr_title: Add pooling support for osu! hit judgements
pr_body:
Proof of concept mostly for comment / feedback. Only implemented for osu! ruleset initially. ~Note that this doesn't cover preload requirements (will only preload the default result type, which is "Perfect" right now).~

~Further improvement could come from making one pool per result type, avoiding child reconstruction on type change (probably what we want).~ (since added)

- [x] Depends on https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/pull/3681.
- [x] Add support for non-osu! rulesets (or at least regression test)
- Closes #8250
pr_comments: While I remember, this PR still needs testing and support in non-osu! rulesets. I don't think it should be a huge step to add so feel free to do this during review if it suits (@smoogipoo), else I'll look into it.

On an initial check, your version seems okay, although I'm not sure I'd choose it over the way I implemented (much of a muchness?). I wanted to avoid adding even more levels of abstraction because it's already getting pretty silly (HitObject -> DrawableHitObject -> Judgement -> DrawableJudgement -> JudgementResult) working on this change was quite hard to follow this chain.

As for the "local implementations", I did mention that when working on this. It is probably something we will want to centralise once we get a feel for how this works. At the end of the day though, the idea is to make pooling flexible and leave it mostly up to the user how to best optimise (to reduce allocs caused by changes applied to the pooled drawables).
Admittedly when implementing the above I didn't think about `SkinnableDrawable`, that came as an afterthought and wouldn't work well with my structure...
Not sure about that being the final iteration, but seems like a step further in the correct direction.
@smoogipoo wanna double-check this one? should just be as-above proposed.

issue_context.title: Lag spikes when displaying animated judgement sprites
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:**  
- Big lag spikes as much as 500ms when the game tries to display an animated judgement sprite (e.g. 100, 50, miss...) 
- Skin tested: [FlyingTuna's skin](https://skins.osuck.net/index.php?newsid=640)
- Most prominent right after game start up, sometimes it goes away after a while sometimes it doesn't
- applies to both gameplay and replay

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
~~will add link after the video finished uploading~~  
https://streamable.com/nejq1

**osu!lazer version:**  
2020.312.0

**Logs:**
[performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4325887/performance.log)
[performance-draw.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4325889/performance-draw.log)
[performance-update.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4325890/performance-update.log)
comments: For reference, the skin is loading 60 frames per judgement (110x220x60 = 132,000 pixels). Not enough that this should happen. @cupppu could you please delete your logs folder, reproduce this once with ctrl-f2 view up (the whole time) and do immediately quit and provide the logs agin? The ones you provided are a bit cluttered.

Same map same skin as in video

[performance-audio.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4457151/performance-audio.log)
[performance-draw.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4457152/performance-draw.log)
[performance-update.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4457154/performance-update.log)
[performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4457155/performance.log)
[network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4457163/network.log)
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4457164/runtime.log)
[database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4457150/database.log)

Can you confirm that this is still reproducible with all performance overlays turned off (Ctrl-F11 to off, Ctrl-F2 to off), on *every* judgement? I can get a minor stutter on first judgement but all future ones seem fine.

I should've clarified: the lag only appears for the first judgement and then the rest is fine, but the judgements are independent of each other i.e. 50, 100, miss gets their own lag spikes.
I still need to see if this is reproducible with Ctrl-F11 completely off
Do note though, my machine is a 2012 macbook so it's quite slow and might have magnified the issue
Thanks for the clarification. I think this is enough to understand how this could be an issue (since I can reproduce on a high end system with the provided skin).
Should be addressed via https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/6136 . Something like a "prepare" method which creates some initial objects during BDL-load.

review_comments:
Is this required? Seems to break taiko judgement positioning (and maybe mania, depends on how it positions it).

Can it be moved to osu! instead if it's required?
Interesting, I didn't even notice. I just moved it here because I thought it was shared across ruleset, it can be reverted without issue.
Actually doesn't seem to be as a result of this PR and centre origin seems to be the general use case (all our rulesets + tau + sentakki)
On another note, this is the sort of stuff that seems better suited to `FreeAfterUse()` to me, in the philosophy of "you broke it, you fix it"?
hmm, so far we've always done the resets in the `Apply` methods (see `UpdateState` of `DrawableHitObjects`) so I went with that here too.
I agree with this being here for the same reason.
OK, I was not aware there was precedent for this.
